release_claim: Do not claim the Urdu sentence section is error-free or linguistically certified. Automated QA passes structural gates only.
root_cause: The workbook builder selects Tatoeba/ManyThings sentence pairs using attribution/script/length checks and an English-side usefulness score. It does not validate Urdu grammar, spelling, idiomaticity, or semantic equivalence before selecting the top 1000. With only 1137 Urdu candidates surviving hard filters, weak learner-facing pairs can enter the final 1000.

normalization_or_editorial_flags.issue: Target-side exclamation mark placement should be normalized: چلو!
Normalize legacy/variant imperative spellings such as کھائو/جائو/بتائو/دکھائو to contemporary کھاؤ/جاؤ/بتاؤ/دکھاؤ.
Normalize non-Urdu yeh code points/orthography (e.g. بخير, کيسا) to Urdu forms.
Prefer standard spacing کون سے over کونسے in this learner corpus.
Remove stray spaces before Urdu punctuation.
Word order is awkward for Weren't they satisfied?; prefer کیا وہ مطمئن نہیں تھے؟.
Missing final Urdu punctuation.
کی جیئے is malformed/spaced; rewrite idiomatically, e.g. براہِ مہربانی، سوچ سمجھ کر انتخاب کیجیے۔
Normalize آرامدہ to آرام دہ.
میں بہت گرم ہوں is literal/awkward for ordinary temperature discomfort; review against مجھے بہت گرمی لگ رہی ہے۔
Normalize چاہیے spelling consistently for a modern learner workbook.
Remove explanatory parenthetical from learner sentence; use an unambiguous natural target such as میں اس لڑکی کو نہیں جانتا۔ if the English must remain I don't know her.
Review word order/naturalness for I don't know that; prefer مجھے یہ معلوم نہیں۔
Long time, no see pair is awkward/incomplete; review تم سے ملے ہوئے کافی عرصہ ہو گیا ہے۔ or replace with a more idiomatic pair.
English includes please but Urdu imperative بولے is not the correct polished respectful form; prefer براہِ مہربانی ... بولیں۔
English adds Please although the target imperatives are direct; either remove Please in English or make Urdu polite.
Normalize فوراً diacritic/encoding.
Normalize آئڈیا to آئیڈیا for the intended loanword.
کوئی ۱ میل is awkward for about 1 mile; prefer تقریباً ایک میل.
دکھائے is not the intended respectful imperative; prefer دکھائیں.
وہ زیادہ ذہین ہے is singular-style while English is plural They are more intelligent; resolve number explicitly.
Colloquial wording بڑی زور کی لگی ہے should receive native editorial review for standard learner register.
نہ ڈالے is not a polished learner-facing imperative for Don't feed the animals; prefer a clear imperative such as جانوروں کو کھانا نہ دیں۔
